scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Welcome
to ^8B4513Einbroch^000000,
the City of Steel.
Please ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
歡迎來到鋼鐵之城^8B4513艾音布羅克^000000。
如果有任何問題，請隨時問我。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於城市的西北部。
在那裡您可以看到我們城市的驕傲——飛空艇。
請記住，搭乘飛空艇需要付費。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, perhaps the
most important facility in
Einbroch, is located in the
southern part of the city.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}可以說是艾音布羅克最重要的設施，位於城市南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0}, our biggest
shopping district, can be
found just east from the
center of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}是我們最大的購物區，就在艾音布羅克中心的東邊。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is east of
the Plaza and offers top
caliber accomodations.
There, you can enjoy your
stay in Einbroch in comfort~
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}就在廣場東邊，提供一流的住宿服務。
住在那裡，您就能舒舒服服地遊覽艾音布羅克了~

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located in the northeast
part of Einbroch. Trains
running between here
and Einbech run all day
long, everyday.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於艾音布羅克東北部。
往返這裡和艾音貝赫的火車，每天全天執行。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located north from the
Plaza. There you can
purchase weapons for
your personal use.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於廣場北邊，您可以在那裡挑選合用的武器。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is an
annex of the Factory and
is located in the southwest
sector of Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}是工廠的附屬設施，位於艾音布羅克的西南部。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
I will mark the location
of the {0}
on your mini-map.
Would you like to check any other locations?
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
我會在您的小地圖上標記{0}的位置。
您還想檢視其他地點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The {0} is
located in the southeast
part of Einbroch. You can
upgrade your equipment
by using their services.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
{0}位於艾音布羅克東南部，您可以在那裡強化裝備。

You may go to ^FF1493Manthasman^000000,
the ^FF1493Armsmith^000000
on the 1st basement floor in the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
您可以去找^FF1493曼薩曼^000000，他是^FF1493武器匠^000000，就在鐵匠公會地下一層。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
You can find
the ^CD1039Eden Teleport Officer^000000
on the 1st floor of the Gunslinger Guild.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布羅克嚮導]
您可以在神槍手公會的一樓找到^CD1039樂園團傳送官^000000。

還需要其他幫助嗎？

[艾音布羅克嚮導]
祝您一路平安！

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
Welcome to ^8B4513Einbech^000000,
the Mining Town. We're
here to assist tourists,
so if you have any questions,
please feel free to ask us.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
歡迎來到礦業城鎮^8B4513艾音貝赫^000000。
我們專門為遊客提供幫助，有問題儘管問。
[酒館]

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} is located
in the southern part of
Einbech. It's a nice place
to relax after a long day.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
{0}位於艾音貝赫南部，是忙碌一天後放鬆身心的好去處。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
You can find the {0} in the center of
Einbech. There, you can
purchase any tools you
might need for your travels.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
您可以在艾音貝赫的中心找到{0}。
在那裡，您可以買到旅途中可能需要的各種道具。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0} are
located in the northwest
and northeast parts of
Einbech. There, you can
take a train to Einbroch.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
{0}位於艾音貝赫的西北部和東北部。
在那裡，您可以搭乘火車前往艾音布羅克。

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The {0}, which is
Einbech's major industry,
is located in the northern
part of this town. It's where
we get all our ores, although monsters get in the miners' way.
scripts.translation:
[艾音貝赫嚮導]
{0}是艾音貝赫的產業支柱，位於城鎮北部。
我們的礦石都來自那裡，不過魔物總是妨礙礦工工作。
